THE TRIP

About the Manali – Kasol Trip

This is the longer Manali and Kasol plan: a complete Himachal getaway with temples and cafés in Manali, a full snow day beyond the Atal Tunnel, and two very different stays, a hotel in Manali and camps in the Parvati Valley.

You visit Hadimba Devi Temple and Old Manali, spend a day at Solang Valley, drive through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu, then head to Kasol for a bonfire evening and a visit to Manikaran Sahib and its hot springs. Rohtang Pass is included only if it is open and the weather allows.

PICKUP
Akshardham Metro, Delhi
STAY
Manali hotel & Kasol camps
MEALS
3 breakfasts & 3 dinners
DIFFICULTY
Easy
WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Manali sightseeing — Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.

Solang Valley — mountain views, with adventure activities at your own cost.

Atal Tunnel drive — a scenic drive towards Lahaul Valley.

Sissu — a waterfall and viewpoints in the mountains.

Kasol camp stay — a peaceful night in the Parvati Valley.

Bonfire and music night — a fun evening with your travel group.

Manikaran Sahib — the Gurudwara, hot springs and langar.

Riverside cafés — relax by the Parvati River.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Assembly: Assemble at Akshardham Metro Station between 9:30 PM and 10:30 PM.
  • Meet & greet: Meet your Trip Captain and fellow travellers.
  • Board: Board the vehicle and begin the journey towards Manali.
  • On the way: Fun introductions, music and group bonding activities.
  • Dinner halt: A roadside dhaba halt for refreshments and dinner (self-paid).
  • Overnight: Overnight journey to Manali.
  • Arrival: Arrive in Manali and check in to the hotel.
  • Rest: Freshen up and relax after the overnight journey.
  • Hadimba Temple: Visit the Hadimba Devi Temple in its cedar forest.
  • Old Manali: Explore the streets and cafés of Old Manali.
  • Mall Road: Shop and stroll at Mall Road.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.
  • Morning: Wake up early and have breakfast.
  • Solang Valley: Enjoy the mountain views. Adventure activities are at your own cost.
  • Rohtang Pass: Visit Rohtang Pass, subject to weather conditions and if it is open.
  • Atal Tunnel: Drive through the Atal Tunnel.
  • Sissu: Explore Sissu’s waterfall and viewpoints, then return to Manali.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.
  • Check-out: Have breakfast and check out from the Manali hotel.
  • Drive: Drive towards the Parvati Valley.
  • Adventure: River rafting or paragliding on the way is optional and at your own cost.
  • Kasol: Reach Kasol and check in to the camps or cottages.
  • Explore: Relax and explore the peaceful surroundings.
  • Night: Bonfire evening, dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Have breakfast and check out from the camp.
  • Manikaran: Visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and its hot water springs.
  • Riverside: Spend leisure time by the Parvati River.
  • Kasol: Explore the market and cafés.
  • Departure: Begin the overnight return journey to Delhi, arriving the next morning.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Transportation Delhi to Delhi (via Manali and Kasol)
  • 3-night stay in Manali and Kasol on sharing basis
  • 6 meals: 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners
  • All sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary
  • Trip led and managed by an experienced Trip Captain
  • Bonfire and music evening (subject to weather)
  • Toll taxes, parking fees and driver allowances
  • Complete trip assistance and on-ground support

Not included in your package

  • Any meals not mentioned in the inclusions
  • Meals during travel or sightseeing
  • Early check-in at hotels
  • Additional services such as room heaters
  • Adventure activities at Solang, rafting and paragliding
  • Tips, laundry, liquor and mineral water
  • Personal items, phone charges and camera fees
  • Any other cost not mentioned in the inclusions
